services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Looking for a beautiful, scenic location for a group event? North Star Camp for Boys is available for rent when camp is not in session! Whether you are planning a wedding, corporate retreat, school trip, sports team training camp, Bar/Bat Mitzvah, family reunion, or surprise party, North Star Camp may be the perfect venue for your special occasion. Our dedicated staff will help you plan all the details to make your event a success, including creating delicious food for meals, running programs and activities, or providing excellent hospitality throughout your visit to camp.
